snippet.title: Welcome to Your Day at the Office | Exit Strategy - Steam Next Fest Demo
snippet.description:
Step into the office and immediately start looking for a way out.

In Exit Strategy, you’re not here to work—you’re here to escape. Crawl through vents, trigger copier chaos, and turn the workplace into a stealthy sandbox of sabotage. Watch as one poor coworker eats it three times in a glorious water spill replay before you casually stroll back into the elevator like nothing happened.

💼 Play the free demo during Steam Next Fest
🕹️ Build and share your own maps
📎 Add to your Wishlist now and escape the 9-to-5 later!
